answer: Work waits on the river until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the tundra of the next round. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the sable of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short.
